goal_summary: Verify every way a book can get into the MyBooks cart and every scenario in which Add to Cart is used, for guests and signed-in shoppers, against the current code and documented contract.

orders, cancellation and refunds.reason: cart is only read by checkout; order status flow is out of this ticket

open_questions.question: No requirement beyond two generic acceptance criteria exists; may the current code, docs/AUTH.md and the openapi summaries serve as the expected behaviour for the cart?

source_says.quote: Every path by which a product can be added to the cart is identified and checked.
guest cart by cookie; login calls /api/cart/merge; higher quantity wins, capped at stock

readings.reading: Documented contract (AUTH.md, openapi) plus current code are the expected behaviour
readings.if_chosen: Cases take their Then from those documents; rows without a document stay marked as code-observed

readings.reading: Tracker stories in REF hold the real requirements and must be supplied first
readings.if_chosen: Plan waits for the supplied stories; unsupported rows stay manual

open_questions.question: Should a guest cart survive registration followed by login, given RegisterPage never calls merge?

source_says.quote: RegisterPage has no merge call (onRegisterSuccess only)

readings.reading: Guest cart is merged after register then login, so losing it is a defect
readings.if_chosen: A Then is written that the guest items appear in the account cart; a failure is reported as a bug

readings.reading: Only a direct sign-in merges; losing the guest cart after registration is accepted
readings.if_chosen: R-9 stays out of scope and the behaviour is recorded as known

open_questions.question: What is expected on the cart page when the quantity input is emptied (NaN is sent) or the cart or book fetch fails?

source_says.quote: NaN from empty input is not guarded and is sent; no response.ok check on either fetch

readings.reading: The page must ignore the empty value and show an error on failed fetches
readings.if_chosen: Cases assert no request with NaN and a visible error; a failure files a bug
R-13 is not tested and recorded as accepted

open_questions.question: Is concurrent adding of the same book in scope, and what must hold (one row, quantity within stock)?

source_says.quote: findFirst then create/update is not atomic

readings.reading: In scope: parallel adds must keep one row and stay within stock
readings.if_chosen: A parallel API check is planned and R-16 gets an observable

readings.reading: Out of scope for this ticket
readings.if_chosen: R-16 stays in the not-verified list
